about.title: Bua
about.intro: {project} mmupampa wa tshikondo tshikuabu wa bagasunga bwa mafayi bwa peer-to-peer mwakeshibwe pa mishindu ya teknolojiya ya makelela idi kayi ne tshikoso tshia pankatshi. Wakanga interface mupepele wa muenzeji ne dilonga dia kayi ne tshikoso tshia pankatshi to, wakangidisha bagasunga bwa data bua kulamuna ne bua kueyemeneka kayi mukalu wa tshilumbuluwa to wa pankatshi. Pulojekiti eu mmu open source, ugabandidibwa muomba mua {license}.

decentralized.title: Mukandu wa kayi ne tshikoso tshia pankatshi to
decentralized.description: Ki mvuluila tshikoso tshia pankatshi to, ki mvuluila tshintu tshimwe tshia kupwa to. Bena kuenza badi bakeba ne bantulula bilumbu ku bena kabidi, kabayi mvuluila ku indexer, tracker peshi database to wa pankatshi.

accessControl.title: Bukokeshi bua kuangatabu pankenyi
accessControl.description: Muntu yonso udi mua kutua mukandu wende ku tshianganji ne mikenji yende. Mu mukandu wonso, fundakaja mishindu ya bena kuenza: muena, admin, mukandidiji, mukolosheji ne musendishi. Kokesha pankenyi ngaye udi mua kukandika, kukolosha ne kusendisha bilumbu.

ui.title: Interface wa muenzeji wa mvulu
ui.description: Interface wa media center mupepele ne wa bulunda wakeshibwe bua mishindu ya desktop, TV ne sambidi. Bagatuluka bipepele ne keyboard, mouse, gamepad peshi telekomonando. Bena kuenza ba lubukidi badi mua kufukila software bu file server kayi ne mpaa to ku command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Mushindu wa data udi mubantu mua kubala
dataFormat.description: Mushindu wa data wa LISH wakeshibwe pa JSON, ufundakaja kubikenza, kubabala ne kubumvwa. Sambakaja bilumbu biebe ne metadata mukenkemejii ne ya pankenyi, muntu yonso udi mua kuyitangila pankenyi.

security.title: Bujidipi ne bumvulu
security.description: Mibikilangu yonso ya peer-to-peer idi muenkripte, bua data wamene kushala mu bujidipi pakuendaye. Bena kuenza badi mua kufiama panyima pa VPN bua kuongesha tshipwilu tshikuabu tshia bujimanya. {project} udi musangiluwila bujidipi buebe pakulamukidibwa kuende.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software udi pa Windows, Linux ne macOS. Wukenze pa tshintu tshionso tshiudi musue.

download.title: Senda mu
download.description: Mvuwatu {project} wa mukandu webe. Misendulu yonso mmua tshianganji ne open source.
